hypothesis: H2b controlled comparison of MLP, LSTM, Transformer, and Mamba with identical Autophase program inputs, ordered frozen candidate tokens, ObjectText NVP targets, and offline policy-45 selection.

candidate_representation.token_semantics: official LLVM action IDs in frozen candidate order; no candidate-ID feature
candidate_representation.padding: right-pad each candidate sequence to length 20; use valid-token lengths for LSTM final state and Transformer padding mask; Mamba is causal and reads the final valid token; MLP masks PAD embeddings before flattening

capacity_envelope.policy: one fixed, materially comparable small-capacity configuration per architecture; actual parameter counts are reported without an invented percentage threshold

training.hyperparameter_selection_seed_policy: one fixed seed 0 per architecture; no result-conditioned expansion
training.lr_schedule: 500-step linear warmup then cosine to lr*0.01 over the remaining 9500 steps
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: maximum ValidationFinalMeanOverOz policy-45 dataset macro mean; deterministic first checkpoint on exact tie

validation.inference: sampling=false; descending logits with candidate-ID ascending tie break
validation.policy: offline independent-reset prefix-label simulation with exactly 45 scored-pass budget

MLP.architecture: position-aware token embeddings plus program conditioning, PAD-masked ordered flattening, two 64-unit ReLU layers, scalar candidate logit

LSTM.architecture: position-aware token embeddings plus program conditioning, two-layer LSTM, final valid-token state, scalar candidate logit

Transformer.architecture: position-aware token embeddings plus program conditioning, two-layer masked Transformer encoder, final valid-token state, scalar candidate logit

Mamba.architecture: position-aware token embeddings plus program conditioning, two residual Mamba blocks, final valid-token state, scalar candidate logit
